title: Distribution of Four-Square Representations Among Orderings

problemStatement.formal: For n = a₁² + a₂² + a₃² + a₄² with 0 ≤ a₁ ≤ a₂ ≤ a₃ ≤ a₄, each sorted representation type contributes permutations × signFactor ordered signed representations, where permutations = 4!/(m₁!···mₖ!) and signFactor = 2^(nonzero count). Total r₄(n) = Σ contributions = 8σ*(n).
problemStatement.plain: Classify all sorted four-square representation types by their multiplicity pattern, prove general contribution formulas for each type family, and verify the orbit-stabilizer structure connecting contributions to the symmetry group S₄ × (ℤ/2ℤ)⁴.
whyMatters: Completes the distributional analysis of Lagrange's four-square theorem
Connects combinatorial type theory to group-theoretic orbit-stabilizer analysis
Provides decidable enumeration making the decomposition fully algorithmic

proven: General trivialType (0,0,0,k) theorem: contribution = 8 for all k > 0
General allEqualType (k,k,k,k) theorem: contribution = 16 for all k > 0
General threeEqualType (0,k,k,k) theorem: contribution = 32 for all k > 0
General twoPairType (a,a,b,b) theorem: contribution = 96 for all 0 < a < b
General twoEqualType (0,0,k,k) theorem: contribution = 24 for all k > 0
General twoNonzeroDistinct (0,0,a,b) theorem: contribution = 48 for all 0 < a < b
Contribution sum verification (totalFromEnum matches known r₄ values) for n = 1..7, 9..11, 13..16
Structural bounds: nonzeroCount ≤ 4, signFactor ≤ 16, permutations ≤ 24, contribution ≤ 384
Complete sign factor classification by nonzero count
Orbit-stabilizer analysis: contribution = 384/|stabilizer| for all type families
Perfect square nontrivial contributions for n = 4, 9, 16
